<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946, which corresponds to a [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of approximately 178.087 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₁H₁₄O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2</final_answer>
